headline: Mineros Approves Extraordinary Dividend of $58.1 Million
summary: Mineros' general assembly of shareholders authorized the distribution of extraordinary dividends amounting to $58.1 million, equivalent to $0.20 per share, drawn from prior-year retained earnings reserves.
why: Extraordinary dividend distributions provide direct cash returns to equity holders and signal corporate cash generation.

impacts.name: Mineros
impacts.why: Large cash dividend distributions directly reward shareholders and reflect strong liquidity positions.
